title: Low Poly SVD Dragunov
author: samanthacford
notes: Runtime first-person + world viewmodel for the new 'svd' marksman rifle (GLB_WEAPONS factory).

Material FIX: the source gltf defines 4 correct materials but the export assigned EVERY mesh to material 0 (the 'AK_Barrel_And_Body' texture, baked PURE BLACK). Each mesh was re-mapped to its named material (mesh-name suffix), restoring the real Guards/Stocks wood, Accesories and Magazine(plum) textures; the black body texture was replaced with a solid gunmetal.
Re-bake proper textures in Blender for final art.
